name: Purpose Statement
description: One participant-visible purpose statement. It may describe an authorized representative role, an intended request pattern and response operation, or a simple non-provider role such as observing. Purpose does not grant authority.

onBehalfOf.description: Optional authority explaining whom the participant represents. A mandate-backed purpose uses Mandate/Mandate Authority, which includes the represented actor and mandate.

event.description: Optional request event type or pattern the participant intends to handle.

respondsWith.description: Optional operation selectors the participant may use in response.

summary.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the participant's purpose.
